license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to call or hold herself or himself out as or use the title of nurse or to practice or offer to practice as a nurse unless licensed or privileged under the provisions of this chapter.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination)
exams.notes: Required for registered nurse licensure; also accepted from another state.
exams.quote: Documentation that the applicant has taken and received a passing score on the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX)

exams.name: NCLEX-PN (National Council Licensure Examination for Practical Nurses)
exams.notes: Required for licensed practical nurse licensure.
exams.quote: Documentation that the applicant has taken and received a passing score on the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX)

exams.name: Jurisprudence Examination
exams.notes: Required for both RN and LPN licensure; covers licensing requirements under KRS Chapter 314 and board regulations.
exams.quote: Has passed the jurisprudence examination approved by the board as provided by subsection (4) of this section

exams.name: National certification examination (APRN)
exams.notes: Required for APRN licensure; must be from a nationally established organization recognized by the board. Provisional licensee has two attempts within 6 months.
exams.quote: Is certified by a nationally established organization or agency recognized by the board to certify registered nurses for advanced practice registered nursing

interval_years.quote: The license of every person issued under the provisions of this chapter shall be renewed for a period of time as determined by the board by administrative regulation

required.quote: As a prerequisite for license renewal, all individuals licensed under provisions of this chapter shall be required to document continuing competency during the immediate past licensure period as prescribed in regulations promulgated by the board.

value: One-time training of at least 1.5 hours on recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma
One-time course of 1 hour on Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia
At least 5 contact hours in pharmacology continuing education for APRNs
topical_requirements.quote: the board shall ensure practitioners licensed under KRS Chapter 314 complete a one-time training course of at least one and one-half (1.5) hours covering the recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse to any applicant who has passed the jurisprudence examination prescribed by the board or its equivalent and who has been licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state or territory if the applicant is a currently licensed registered nurse in good standing in each state or territory in which the applicant has worked.

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed the jurisprudence examination (or equivalent) and hold a current license in good standing in each state/territory where they have worked. For APRN endorsement, must also meet APRN qualification requirements. Board accepts another state's licensure examination as sufficient.
requirements.quote: The board shall accept the licensure examination of another state as sufficient for licensure under this subsection.

national_certification.value: American Nurses' Association or other nationally established organizations or agencies recognized by the board
national_certification.quote: certified by the American Nurses' Association or other nationally established organizations or agencies recognized by the board to certify registered nurses for advanced practice registered nursing

national_association.quote: consistent either with American Nurses' Association Scope and Standards of Practice or with standards of practice established by nationally accepted organizations of registered nurses

credential_type.quote: the board may issue to the applicant a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to call or hold herself or himself out as or use the title of nurse or to practice or offer to practice as a nurse unless licensed or privileged under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice as a registered nurse in this state shall have the right to use the title "registered nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N." No other person shall assume the title or use the abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs, or figures to indicate that the person using the same is a registered nurse.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice as a registered nurse unless licensed under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license, credential, or privilege to practice nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license, credential, or privilege to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or a misdemeanor involving drugs, alcohol, fraud, deceit, falsification of records, a breach of trust, physical harm or endangerment to others, or dishonesty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any felony, or a misdemeanor involving drugs, alcohol, fraud, deceit, falsification of records, a breach of trust, physical harm or endangerment to others, or dishonesty, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor under KRS Chapter 510 involving a patient or a felony under KRS Chapter 510, or sexual contact with a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a misdemeanor offense under KRS Chapter 510 involving a patient, or a felony offense under KRS Chapter 510, 530.064(1)(a), or 531.310, or has been found by the board to have had sexual contact as defined in KRS 510.010(7) with a patient while the patient was under the care of the nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligently or willfully acted in a manner inconsistent with the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has negligently or willfully acted in a manner inconsistent with the practice of nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence or other causes, including inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence or other causes, including but not limited to, being unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuses controlled substances, prescription medications, illegal substances, or alcohol.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuses controlled substances, prescription medications, illegal substances, or alcohol

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misused or misappropriated any drugs placed in the custody of the nurse for administration or use of others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has misused or misappropriated any drugs placed in the custody of the nurse for administration, or for use of others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsified or negligently made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on essential records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on essential records

disciplinary_grounds.description: License, privilege, or credential to practice as a nurse denied, limited, suspended, probated, revoked, or otherwise disciplined in another jurisdiction on grounds sufficient to cause the same in Kentucky.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a license, privilege, or credential to practice as a nurse denied, limited, suspended, probated, revoked, or otherwise disciplined in another jurisdiction on grounds sufficient to cause a license or privilege to be denied, limited, suspended, probated, revoked, or otherwise disciplined in this Commonwealth

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any of the provisions of KRS Chapter 314.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any lawful order or directive previously entered by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any lawful order or directive previously entered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any administrative regulation promulgated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any administrative regulation promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Listed on either the adult caregiver misconduct registry or the nurse aide abuse registry with a substantiated finding, or has a substantiated or judicial finding of child abuse or neglect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been listed on either the adult caregiver misconduct registry or the nurse aide abuse registry with a substantiated finding of abuse, neglect, or misappropriation of property, or has a substantiated finding or judicial finding of the abuse or neglect of a child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient, except as authorized or required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient, except as authorized or required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used or possessed a Schedule I controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used or possessed a Schedule I controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used or was impaired as a consequence of the use of alcohol or drugs while practicing as a nurse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has used or been impaired as a consequence of the use of alcohol or drugs while practicing as a nurse

definition_quote.value: Registered nursing practice means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skill based upon the principles of psychological, biological, physical, and social sciences in the application of the nursing process in: (a) The care, counsel, and health teaching of the ill, injured, or infirm; (b) The maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others; (c) The administration of medication and treatment as prescribed by a physician, physician assistant, dentist, or advanced practice registered nurse; (d) The supervision, teaching of, and delegation to other personnel in the performance of activities relating to nursing care; and (e) The performance of other nursing acts which are authorized or limited by the board.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered nursing practice" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skill based upon the principles of psychological, biological, physical, and social sciences in the application of the nursing process

full_independent_practice_available.quote: After four (4) years of prescribing with a CAPA-NS in collaboration with a physician: ... The advanced practice registered nurse will no longer be required to maintain a CAPA-NS and shall not be compelled to maintain a CAPA-NS as a condition to prescribe after the four (4) years have expired

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: before an advanced practice registered nurse engages in the prescribing or dispensing of nonscheduled legend drugs as authorized by KRS 314.011(8), the advanced practice registered nurse shall enter into a written "Collaborative Agreement for the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse's Prescriptive Authority for Nonscheduled Legend Drugs" (CAPA-NS) with a physician licensed in Kentucky

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: to issue prescriptions for but not to dispense Schedules II through V controlled substances described in or as classified pursuant to KRS 218A.020, 218A.060, 218A.080, 218A.100, and 218A.120

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Prescriptions for Schedule II controlled substances (except hydrocodone combination products) limited to a 72-hour supply without refill. Hydrocodone combination products limited to a 30-day supply without refill.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Prescriptions issued by advanced practice registered nurses for Schedule II controlled substances classified under KRS 218A.060, except hydrocodone combination products as defined in KRS 218A.010, shall be limited to a seventy-two (72) hour supply without any refill.

dea_registration_required.quote: Prior to prescribing controlled substances, the advanced practice registered nurse shall obtain a Controlled Substance Registration Certificate through the United States Drug Enforcement Administration.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Within thirty (30) days of obtaining a Controlled Substance Registration Certificate from the United States Drug Enforcement Administration, and prior to prescribing controlled substances, the advanced practice registered nurse shall register with the electronic system for monitoring controlled substances established by KRS 218A.202

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: The Kentucky Board of Nursing shall promulgate administrative regulations in accordance with KRS Chapter 13A to establish the following for the credentialing of medication aides

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Delegation" means directing a competent person to perform a selected nursing activity or task in a selected situation under the nurse's supervision and pursuant to administrative regulations promulgated by the board

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any nurse, employer of nurses, or any person having knowledge of facts to refrain from reporting to the board a nurse who is suspected of having violated any provision of KRS 314.091(1).

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the Compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: This Compact shall apply only to those nurses who hold a multistate license.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board may establish an alternative to discipline program to promote the early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of nurses who may be impaired by reason of alcohol or drug abuse.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse who is employed by a health facility as defined in KRS 216B.015 may determine whether or not a patient is dead in accordance with the requirements of KRS 446.400.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A treating nurse who provides or facilitates the use of telehealth shall ensure that the informed consent of the patient is obtained before services are provided and that confidentiality is maintained. The board shall promulgate administrative regulations to prevent abuse and fraud through telehealth services.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A treating nurse who provides or facilitates the use of telehealth shall ensure: (a) That the informed consent of the patient, or another appropriate person with authority to make the health care treatment decision for the patient, is obtained before services are provided through telehealth

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as requiring an advanced practice registered nurse designated by the board as a certified registered nurse anesthetist to enter into a collaborative agreement with a physician, pursuant to this chapter or any other provision of law, in order to deliver anesthesia care.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to provide certified professional midwifery services as defined in KRS 314.400 unless that person is a licensed certified professional midwife currently issued a license by the board

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: before an advanced practice registered nurse engages in the prescribing or dispensing of nonscheduled legend drugs as authorized by KRS 314.011(8), the advanced practice registered nurse shall enter into a written "Collaborative Agreement for the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse's Prescriptive Authority for Nonscheduled Legend Drugs" (CAPA-NS) with a physician licensed in Kentucky that defines the scope of the prescriptive authority for nonscheduled legend drugs.
